step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture process begins with external comments hosted on regulations.gov (API regulations.gov). An AWS Lambda function executes daily to ingest new raw comment data and store it in an Amazon S3 Data Store. Once staged, an Amazon SageMaker Notebook reads the raw data from S3, cleans special characters and markdown formatting, and writes clean CSV files back to the S3 Data Store. Next, three parallel ML components fetch the cleaned data from S3: Amazon Bedrock Titan identifies expert content and language complexity, SageMaker Hugging Face Flan UL2 performs lightweight sentiment analysis with high accuracy, and a SageMaker Notebook runs Scikit-learn algorithms for clustering form letters and grade-level filtering. The outputs from all three ML components are stored into an Amazon S3 BI Data Store in CSV format. Finally, the processed data in the BI S3 bucket is consumed by external BI Campaign Reporting tools (Tableau) for daily campaign analytics.
